title: iface_ack (Backend to agent)
description: The Backend's answer to one upload. outcome is an informational string: success is anything not starting with refused (nothing was recorded, the bytes are not resent). Only iface_hello is answered with a fixed word, recorded; for results and events the outcome is whatever the Backend's handler returns. duplicate is success for events.

outcome.description: Informational. Success unless it starts with refused.
